Machine Learning is becoming an essential skill for engineers and is now a key component of major hackathons and industry projects. ML Bubble provides students with an opportunity to explore real-world problems and develop ML-based solutions according to their academic level.

The event is divided into three tracks:

FE – Explore & Identify
Identify a real-world problem.
Explain why Machine Learning can help solve it.
Submit a short presentation or write-up.
SE – Design & Solve
Design an ML-based solution.
Train a working model.
Present results and evaluation metrics.
Submit PPT and model.
TE-BE – Design & Solve (Advanced)
Build and train a working ML model.
Present results and performance metrics.
Include comparative analysis and deployment considerations.
